5739.title: Sidebar modifier-click navigation
5739.rootCauseOneLine: Rail destinations are buttons; thread anchors cancel Ctrl/Meta-click to open an in-app split.
5739.proposedFix: Decide a non-conflicting split gesture, expose host-resolved destination URLs, and preserve native modified-click behavior on navigation anchors.
5739.caveats: Reproduced through real components in two clean checkouts. Browser Automation lacked Chrome, so Vivaldi/Windows and actual new-tab creation were not exercised. No automatic PR: shortcut policy and coordinated routing/SDK work exceed simple-fix scope. Diagnostic patch and outputs are embedded in the report.
